correctness.rationale: The nonnegative fundamental Hermite–Fejer basis h_k=T_n(x)^2(1-xx_k)/(n^2(x-x_k)^2) partitions unity, making every BV output a linear combination of step responses F_m. BV seminorm is exactly the maximum Var(F_m), attained by a one-jump input. All n nodal derivative zeros plus one interior extremum in each of the n-2 equal-label gaps exhaust deg F_m<=2n-2 derivative, proving the exact variation accounting. The angular kernel splits into direct and reflected csc^2 terms; reflected double sums stay uniformly bounded and direct tails give <=(2/pi^2)(log m+log(n-m))+O(1). Evaluating central-step gaps at angles j*pi/n yields both harmonic lower tails and 4/pi^2 log n+O(1). Independent numerical optimization for n=8,16,32,64 produced 1.8685,2.1509,2.4323,2.7134 respectively, consistent with the logarithmic slope (the additive constant persists).
